paper_id: E2CNN_ entity-type-enriched cascaded neural network for Chinese financial relation extraction
title: E2CNN: entity-type-enriched cascaded neural network for Chinese financial relation extraction
motivation: Chinese financial knowledge graphs are crucial for anti-fraud but construction is hindered by complex semantics and the overlap triple problem (62.91% entities appear in multiple relations).
problem_framing: Define relation extraction in Chinese financial corpus as handling Entity Pair Overlap and Single Entity Overlap, where over 39% of triples exhibit overlap.
key_insight: Entity types provide consistency (same-type entities share relation patterns) and exclusion (certain entity-relation combinations are impossible), acting as implicit constraints for relation extraction.
method_signature: E2CNN: BERT encoding with [e:type] markers + span-type identification + cascaded subject-then-object extraction per relation.
evaluation_criteria: F1/P/R on end-to-end triple extraction (correct entity boundaries + relation type); ablation on type prediction errors.
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Threshold for object detection fixed at 0.5; authors admit it 'has the potential for optimization' but postpone to future work.
evidence_for_taste: after removing the type information, the proportions of false type and non-entity both increase
E2CNN outperforms SOTA by 19.7% and 28.69% on F1
the learned knowledge graph is publicly available on GitHub
thinking_moves: 把overlap triple问题拆解为subject提取和relation-specific object提取的级联
从domain-specific数据特性出发发现类型约束（一致性+排斥性）
通过消融实验量化类型信息的贡献而非仅报告端到端结果
